title: Refactor four copies of the file-saving code into one module, and fix its leak
prompt:
catalog.py, customers.py, orders.py and inventory.py each have their own copy of the JSON load/save code (version check, temp file, atomic move). Move that into one new module, tally/storage.py, and make the four classes use it. No other module in tally/ should import json or tempfile or do the temp-file dance itself afterwards.

Behaviour must not change: the same bytes on disk, the same error messages, missing files still load as empty. While you're there, fix one known bug: when a save fails (disk full, permission denied, target is a folder), the temp file is left behind next to the data file. A failed save must leave the old file untouched and no temp file. Keep the existing tests passing.
